description: Source code for M3U playlist parser used in Android's media framework, handling parsing of M3U8 files including metadata, stream info, and URL resolution.

classes.name: M3UParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing M3U8 playlist files, extracting media segments, metadata, and stream information.

methods.name: MakeURL
methods.description: Constructs an absolute URL from a base URL and a relative or absolute path.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing function that processes the data buffer line by line to extract playlist information.

methods.name: parseMetaData
methods.description: Parses metadata lines with key-value pairs, such as target duration or media sequence.

methods.name: parseStreamInf
methods.description: Parses stream information lines, extracting bandwidth and other attributes.

methods.name: FindNextUnquoted
methods.description: Finds the next occurrence of a character outside of quoted strings.

methods.name: parseCipherInfo
methods.description: Parses encryption key information from lines starting with #EXT-X-KEY.

methods.name: parseByteRange
methods.description: Parses byte range specifications for media segments.

methods.name: ParseInt32
methods.description: Converts a string to a 32-bit integer, with error checking.

methods.name: ParseDouble
methods.description: Converts a string to a double, with error checking.
